seo.title: Your Company — forged decor and loft lamps in Tashkent
seo.description: Forged hooks, candle holders, wall panels, lamps and loft shelves in waxed black steel. Workshop and showroom in Yunusabad, made to order.
seo.answer: Your Company is a workshop and showroom in Yunusabad making forged decor and loft accessories in black steel. Hooks from 120,000 UZS, candle holders from 260,000 UZS, wall panels from 900,000 UZS, loft lamps from 1,100,000 UZS. Custom pieces take 5–10 days; phone +998 71 200-04-05.

listing.description: A website for a forged decor and loft accessories workshop: graphic sketches drawn line by line, a work catalogue, makers and prices.

sections.label: Workshop
sections.title: Metal you want to touch
sections.text: We are a small workshop with a forge in the yard and a showroom on the ground floor. We do not paint: we heat each piece, rub in hot wax and polish it with a brush. The result is a warm black with a brown sheen that will not chip and only gets better with age.

items.title: Measurement
items.text: Send a photo of the wall or visit the showroom and we pick the size.

items.title: Sketch
items.text: Lola draws a life-size sketch. Revisions are free.

items.title: Fabrication
items.text: We forge and assemble and send you a video of the process.

items.title: Finishing
items.text: Hot wax instead of paint for a warm, glowing black.

items.title: Installation
items.text: We hang it anywhere in Tashkent or pack it in a gift box.

items.a: Not indoors — the wax seals it. For bathrooms and outdoors we add a clear lacquer coat.

items.q: Do you ship to the regions?
items.a: Yes, we pack in a padded box and ship by courier.
